info.description: High-performance Modular Monolith backend for food & marketplace delivery platform.
info.title: Foodeli Core API

post.description: Authenticate user and issue JWT accessToken cookie and bearer token

get.description: Retrieve profile of currently authenticated user

post.description: Register a new customer or merchant account

get.description: Retrieve customer's active shopping cart stored in Redis

delete.description: Empty all items in customer's cart

post.description: Convert active cart into a confirmed pending order and atomic stock reservation
Add a product with quantity to cart (enforces single-store cart unless force=true)

put.description: Modify the quantity of a product in the cart

delete.description: Remove a specific product from customer's cart

post.description: Place an order directly with items and address

get.description: Retrieve order history for the authenticated customer
Retrieve all incoming orders for the merchant's store
Retrieve order details by ID for owner customer or store merchant

patch.description: Transition order status (PENDING -> CONFIRMED -> PREPARING -> DELIVERED or CANCELLED)

post.description: Initiate a TyrFintech hosted checkout session for wallet or external payment

get.description: Retrieve payment receipt details for an order

post.description: Process direct credit card payment for an order via TyrFintech
Add a new product to merchant's store

get.description: Retrieve all products belonging to a store

put.description: Update existing product details in merchant's store

delete.description: Soft-delete a product from merchant's store

get.description: Retrieve list of all registered stores

post.description: Register a new merchant storefront (enforces 1 store per merchant)

get.description: Retrieve the store belonging to the currently logged in merchant
Retrieve store details by unique ID
Retrieve all menu items for a specific store

post.description: Add a new menu item to merchant's store
Receive and idempotently process asynchronous payment events from TyrFintech

force.description: If true and cart has items from another store, clears old cart

BearerAuth.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and your JWT token. Example: "Bearer eyJhbGciOi..."
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
